purpose: What each provider can be asked to do, in which phase, with how many attempts, and which outcomes are possible. The matrix is documentation, so a row may only claim readiness that connectors/recipes and connectors/fixtures/acceptance_worksheet.json already support.

readiness_meaning.ready: Steed can run this end to end against a reviewed template.
readiness_meaning.manual: Steed can produce the evidence, but a person performs the confirming step outside Steed because no read tool covers the created object.
readiness_meaning.not_applicable: The task cannot exist for this provider, and the reason is recorded.
readiness_meaning.pending_owner_approval: The step is written but may not run without an owner decision.

outcome_meaning.succeeded: The provider answered and Steed returned reviewed fields.
outcome_meaning.not_applied: Steed refused or the provider rejected the request before an object changed.
outcome_meaning.uncertain: The request left Steed and the answer is unknown, so the object may or may not exist.
outcome_meaning.blocked: Steed stopped before dispatch, for example an unreviewed payload or a missing destination.
outcome_meaning.not_applicable: The phase does not exist for this provider.

attempt_rules: A read is attempted once. A transport failure is surfaced, never retried automatically.
A write is attempted once. An uncertain write is reported as uncertain and never resent, because a resend can duplicate an object.
A confirming read is attempted once and is performed by the caller, not by the write.

deferred.reason: A data-source query is a POST that needs an integration token and a real database, so it is a gated case, not a starter task.
Every Linear read is a POST GraphQL query, so identity and context are gated cases rather than reviewed recipes.
Identity and folder reads are POST routes with a documented continuation, so they are gated cases.
Figma file reads need a personal access token header and an empirical body bound, so the documented cases stay ungated-free of a shared POST-read contract and no starter task is claimed.
Item reads need a service account and session authorization that cannot be reviewed without a live vault, so no case is published.
